basic_info.description: Welcome to this delightful single-family home located on a lovely block in Visitacion Valley, just steps from Leland Avenue with its local shops, eateries, and conveniences. The neighborhood is cozy and inviting, with easy access to freeways, public transportation, and shopping.    The main level is filled with natural light and features a cheerful living room, two comfortable bedrooms plus a sunroom, a full bath, and a spacious eat-in kitchen with a cozy breakfast nook. The home is enhanced by beautiful hardwood floors throughout, fresh interior paint, and newer double-pane windows.    The spacious garage easily parks two cars with plenty of room left for storage, along with laundry hookups for added convenience. Toward the rear, you'll find a versatile bonus area set up as a sitting room and bedroom with its own full bath and direct access to the private backyard. The outdoor space includes a lovely garden patio, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. This additional living space also has its own street entrance, providing flexibility for guests, extended family, or a home office.    Don't miss the opportunity to own this special property in one of San Francisco's most convenient and charming neighborhoods!
